title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: If \(\angle A = 60°,\) \(\angle E = 40°,\) and \(\angle C = 30°,\) then \(\angle BDC =\)

solutions.text:
In triangle \(ABE,\) \(\angle ABE = 180°\) \(- (60° + 40°)\) \(= 80°.\)

Since \(A, B, C\) are collinear and \(D\) lies on segment \(EB,\) the angle \(\angle DBC = 180° - 80° = 100°.\)

In triangle \(BDC,\) \(\angle BDC = 180°\) \(- (100° + 30°)\) \(= 50°.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: In triangle \(ABE\), the angles at \(A\) and \(E\) determine the angle \(\angle ABE\)
Since \(D\) lies on \(EB\) and \(A, B, C\) are collinear, \(\angle DBC\) is the supplement of \(\angle ABE\); then use triangle \(BDC\)
